bullets: The STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller is designed for a wide range of applications, including environmental monitoring, industrial automation, and home automation.

One of the primary applications of this microcontroller is in soil moisture monitoring. The ADC1_IN0 pin is connected to an analog soil moisture sensor, which provides an analog voltage measurement (12-bit ADC) that can be used to determine the moisture content of the soil.

The Active Buzzer Alert Driver on PA1 can be triggered by low soil moisture levels, providing audible alerts when action is needed. This feature helps in maintaining a healthy environment and preventing waterlogging.
